name: cta-section
title: Cta Section
description: Call-to-action section. Title + description + 1-2 action buttons in a centred column on a tinted surface. The shape every landing page reaches for ("Ready to ship?" / "Start your trial" / "Read the docs"). Server component.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/cta-section

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/cta-section.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/cta-section';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/cta-section

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
